prompt: Composition: Aligned comparison rows, sticky labels, compact toolbar, no hero. Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Use Marine and Coral: page #F7FCFF, text #113C50, accent #B73545, secondary surface #E5F3F8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 80px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 16px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
